items.label: USAO-MA civil: Nova Psychiatric Services, P.C. and Patriot Eldercare, Inc.
items.detail: False Claims Act settlement over billing Medicare, Medicaid and the GIC for psychotherapy and medication management not performed; date is the announcement date. The two clinics and their owner physician pay $1.4 million together; owner left out. Parties admitted certain facts, so admitted is left blank as a mixed case. | Not counted in the total. Shared total, split not stated by the source: counted for no company, kept in gross (overlap group shared-usao-ma-2026-prime-behavioral-health; listed under Amounts not counted).
